message.content: {"label": "RISKY", "explanation": "The old `_resolve_last_org_slug` returned `None` for anonymous/unauthenticated users (falling through to `return None` at the end without entering the membership check), but the new `_resolve_last_org` has the same fall-through path returning `None`—however, for anonymous users the org object is fetched but membership is never checked and `None` is returned, which is unchanged; the real risk is that `features.has('organizations:customer-domains', last_org)` is now called with `last_org=None` when there is no last org, which may unexpectedly enable the feature globally if the feature flag has a global/default-on configuration, potentially exposing customer-domains behavior to all users regardless of organization membership."}
